The main elevators and central staircases are located near the atrium entrance opposite the Silver Jubilee Lawn. [Synthetic demonstration record for campus navigation]

Replacement cards are printed within 48 business hours. [Synthetic demonstration record for ID card re-issuance]

title: Course Registration (FFCS) Add/Drop Window and Credit Limits
content: Under the Fully Flexible Credit System (FFCS), course registration opens in staggered slots based on cumulative earned credits and CGPA. Students must register for a minimum of 16 credits and a maximum of 27 credits per semester (unless given prior overload permission by the Academic Dean). The Course Add/Drop window opens on the third day of instruction and remains active for exactly five academic days. Late registrations incur a disciplinary hold. title: Minimum Attendance Requirements and Medical Leave Condonation
content: Students are required to maintain a minimum attendance of 75% in every theory and practical course to qualify for final end-term examinations. Students with attendance between 65% and 74% due to documented hospitalization or sanctioned university sports/technical representation may submit a Medical Leave or On-Duty (OD) form within 3 business days of return to class. Attendance below 65% results in course debarment and mandatory re-registration. [Synthetic demonstration record for attendance policies]

title: Event Registration Cancellation and Team Withdrawal Policy
content: Students or teams registered for campus hackathons, technical symposiums, or cultural competitions who cannot participate must submit a formal deregistration request via the Student Intranet portal (Events > My Registrations > Request Cancellation) at least 48 hours prior to the event start. For team events, if an individual member withdraws, the remaining team leader may submit a substitute participant request up to 24 hours before the event. Paid workshop registrations cancelled within the 48-hour window receive an automatic synthetic fee credit voucher within 5 business days. Late cancellations within 24 hours or unexcused no-shows forfeit eligibility for event participation certificates and may incur an administrative flag for future symposium registrations. [Synthetic demonstration record for event cancellation policy]
